headline.definition: mean of the relation MCC and the group MCC, on raw (unfloored) decisions

benchmark.measures: How accurately a System One model (one pass of typed decisions: relations between propositions, groups of members, bindings, readings) understands the logical relationships in league rule worlds.
benchmark.name: Mentat-Hard

ci.method: league bootstrap: B draws of the 18 leagues with replacement (random.Random('league_ci:0')), the same draws for every run; 95% percentile intervals (numpy, linear); paired gaps, reference minus run; rank intervals from B = 20000 of the same draws

resolved_comparisons_note: Only gaps to the reference are paired. An interval that excludes 0 is resolved; an interval that includes 0 is not. Overlapping intervals among non-reference runs are not a test of a tie, and the paired comparison among them is not computed (the analysis computes it).
